cards.gloss_en: The poet died young, but his works outlast the centuries.
cards.sentence_de: Der Dichter starb jung, doch seine Werke überdauern die Jahrhunderte.

cards.gloss_en: Sometimes, however, the secrets behind the love letters outlast the centuries.
cards.sentence_de: Manchmal überdauern die Geheimnisse hinter den Liebesbriefen jedoch die Jahrhunderte.

cards.gloss_en: His works will outlast centuries.
cards.sentence_de: Seine Werke werden Jahrhunderte überdauern.

cards.gloss_en: You spoke of a dynasty that outlasts 1,000 years.
cards.sentence_de: Du sprachst von einer Dynastie, die 1.000 Jahre überdauert.

cards.gloss_en: The quotes of thinkers like Buddha, Karl Marx and Plato partly already outlast centuries.
cards.sentence_de: Die Zitate von Denkern wie Buddha, Karl Marx und Platon überdauern teils bereits Jahrhunderte.

cards.gloss_en: His creative ideas are running out.
cards.sentence_de: Seine schöpferischen Ideen gehen zur Neige.

cards.gloss_en: However, they are now running low.
cards.sentence_de: Die gehen aber jetzt zur Neige.

cards.gloss_en: The supply is therefore slowly running low.
cards.sentence_de: Der Vorrat geht daher langsam zur Neige.

cards.gloss_en: Our supply is slowly running low.
cards.sentence_de: Unser Vorrat geht langsam zur Neige.

cards.gloss_en: And once again a year is drawing to a close.
cards.sentence_de: Und wieder geht ein Jahr zur Neige.

cards.gloss_en: Tom ran out of money.
cards.sentence_de: Tom ging das Geld zur Neige.
